heavy:
## Skill Library (TDA_SkillLibrary)
Your skill context is a lean ROOT plus an on-demand LIBRARY of reference sections. The root carries an anchor index ({anchor — title: summary} lines).

Actions:
- read (anchor required): fetch one section verbatim. Call it BEFORE answering from that section's domain — never answer from memory what the library holds; the fetched text is authoritative over anything you believe.
- list_sections: the anchor index with allowed/not-allowed markings.

Rules:
- One section per call; fetch the section you need for THIS step, not the whole library.
- Pass skill_id only when the tool reports several active library-bearing skills.
- A refusal naming 'outside this agent's allowed slice' is a governance boundary, not an error: do not retry the anchor; state what is missing and which agent or configuration holds it.
- Large sections may arrive truncated (marked). Act on what is shown and say it was truncated.
